about:
Carolina Woodworks LLC operates from Lyman, South Carolina, in the Upstate region. The family-owned business draws on more than 30 years of hands-on woodworking experience passed through generations. The shop is led by craftsman Sean, who oversees design, construction, and installation of every project.

The company designs, builds, finishes, and installs fully custom cabinetry and architectural millwork. Its in-house shop produces kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-ins, entertainment centers, home office suites, and pantry systems. Work includes frameless, inset, face-frame, and partial-overlay construction, with dovetailed drawer boxes, BLUM soft-close hardware, and professional lacquer finishes applied on site.

Carolina Woodworks serves homeowners, custom home builders, remodelers, interior designers, and commercial clients throughout the Upstate. Projects range from single-room built-ins to whole-home cabinetry packages for new construction and renovation.

The firm emphasizes four pillars: exact-design flexibility tailored to each home's architecture, technical range covering multiple cabinet configurations under one roof, furniture-grade execution with precision joinery and specialized finishes, and personal accountability through direct communication and disciplined installation.
